purpose: Check documented SystemBasicProcessInformation capability and bounded record decoding as a candidate repair for the benchmark observer.

preserved_preparation.reason: The initial parser accepted a non-null zero-length PID-zero name pointer at an owning record or buffer end. Successor002 tightens both strict bounds and adds two distinct negative cases. All predecessor source and unexecuted build files remain preserved.

limits: Single capability and record-decoding observation only. Microsoft compares this API with SystemProcessInformation, not with Toolhelp. No controlled Toolhelp comparison or speedup is established.
The current observer decoder rejects empty PID-zero names. No adapter has been qualified and no native provider is adopted.
No held-process identity, Job membership, owner/deadline cleanup, full observer phase or competitive product performance is established by this standalone program.
QPC encloses the query and immediately following precise UTC upper stamp. It excludes decoding and output; no atomic whole-host snapshot or UTC/QPC clock equivalence is claimed.
The ABI is limited to documented class252 on supported Windows11 builds and the asserted AMD64 layout. Fixed buffer/capacity or unknown layout errors refuse without fallback or retry.
Loaded ntdll path was checked and selected disk/build inputs pinned; complete loaded-byte immutability and full transitive compiler-input closure are not established.
Raw machine records stay private. The portable component sources support independent capability reproduction; this summary and hashes are not the comprehensive public academic benchmark package.
